there is fun to be had, but these issues have been present since release and shot no signs of being adjusted or fixed in meaningful ways. 

-High cheater count no being handled 
-very poor weapon balance being tailored by irrelevant spreadsheet data
-skins that look like they were put together by A.I. with absolutely no soul or creativity put into them. 
-very simple fetch quests that have you going to many of the same places doing the same things
-loot is labeled on the map where the good stuff is with no variation so fights only ever happen at the same 1 or 2 locations
-the enemy AI is very simple in its design and often interrupt any PVP you may be looking for. 
-movement is clunky with long recovery times on animations and your character gets stuck on all the assets rather than sliding around them.
-geometry is poor for the opposite reason, you slide off ALL the rock formations and one of the maps is mostly a mountain side, mounting can be difficult on those rocks, momentum is lost causing your character to jump in place or slide at a laughably slow speed.
-the players skill tree has very little to no impact on gameplay, they either are bugged or their values are so minute that its difficult to notice them at all.
-there are still many places players can get outside or under the map to shoot players from where they cant get shot in return. it took embark months to fix just one of them and its was the easiest one to fix. all they had to do was remove one rope and they couldnt figure it out for months.
